title: Directors Service Address
intro: We provide a prestigious directors service address to protect your privacy and ensure compliance with statutory requirements.
includes: Legal Requirement for Ltd Companies & LLPs Directors
Receive documents from government bodies & HMRC legal notices individually
Residential address remains hidden from fraudsters

body: While registering your UK limited company as a director if you feel that you need to protect your privacy without even sharing your personal address, go for our director’s service address. Protect the privacy of your home and enhance your corporate image with our prestigious London director service address, with all official government mail scanned and emailed to you, free of charge.
You can change your service address anytime. The £30 charge covers services for only one director of a Company. A director having a different company will have to pay and take the service separately.

Its mandatory to provide a director’s service address to Companies House for a limited company, its shareholders,Companies secretary,LLP members or People with Significant Control (PSCs). That’s why its important for us to collect and verify your proof of ID and address to comply with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements and the London Local Authorities Act.

**Facts to remember** : If you wish to use this address for more than one director, a director service address should be purchased for each director separately. Official government mail is classified as mail from all UK government bodies, as well as Court documents.General commercial correspondence is not handled by this service.
